sqlConfig.query: SELECT DISTINCT project_name::text AS label, project_name::text AS value FROM (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) options WHERE project_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY label

SELECT DISTINCT customer_name::text AS label, customer_name::text AS value FROM (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) options WHERE customer_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY label

WITH b AS (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_finished AND order_type=7 THEN sale_order_amount END)::numeric,2) AS "销售金额", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_finished AND order_type=7 THEN order_cost_amount END)::numeric,2) AS "销售成本", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_finished AND order_type=8 THEN order_cost_amount END)::numeric,2) AS "赠送成本", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_finished AND order_type=6 THEN order_cost_amount END)::numeric,2) AS "坏账单成本", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_finished AND order_type=6 THEN rent_change_amount END)::numeric,2) AS "坏账单租金变动", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_finished THEN total_extra_price END)::numeric,2) AS "额外费用报价" FROM b WHERE business_time >= {{dateFrom}}::date AND business_time < ({{dateTo}}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') [[AND project_name = {{projectName}}]] [[AND customer_name = {{customerName}}]]

config.text: 费用成本（明细状态待确认）

sqlConfig.query: WITH b AS (SELECT x.*,o.project_name,o.customer_name,COALESCE(x.title,'未命名费用') AS cost_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_extra_cost x JOIN (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) o ON x.order_id=o.order_id AND x.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE x.del_flag='0') SELECT cost_name AS "费用名称", ROUND(SUM(cost_amount)::numeric,2) AS "费用成本" FROM b WHERE create_time >= {{dateFrom}}::date AND create_time < ({{dateTo}}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') [[AND project_name = {{projectName}}]] [[AND customer_name = {{customerName}}]] GROUP BY cost_name ORDER BY cost_name

WITH b AS (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) SELECT project_name AS "项目", ROUND(SUM(order_cost_amount)::numeric,2) AS "坏账单成本" FROM b WHERE business_time >= {{dateFrom}}::date AND business_time < ({{dateTo}}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') [[AND project_name = {{projectName}}]] [[AND customer_name = {{customerName}}]] AND is_finished AND order_type=6 GROUP BY project_name ORDER BY ROUND(SUM(order_cost_amount)::numeric,2) DESC LIMIT 15

WITH b AS (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) SELECT order_code AS "报花单号", project_name AS "项目", customer_name AS "客户", type_name AS "业务类型", sale_order_amount AS "销售金额", order_cost_amount AS "处理成本", total_extra_price AS "额外费用报价", business_time AS "业务时间" FROM b WHERE business_time >= {{dateFrom}}::date AND business_time < ({{dateTo}}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') [[AND project_name = {{projectName}}]] [[AND customer_name = {{customerName}}]] AND is_finished AND (order_type IN (6,7,8) OR total_extra_price IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY business_time DESC LIMIT 200
